# go-modern-context-after-func

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use context.AfterFunc to run cleanup when a context is canceled.

## Details

context.AfterFunc registers work to run after cancellation and returns a stop function.
It avoids starting a goroutine whose only job is to wait on ctx.Done.

## Examples

### Before

```go
go func() {
  <-ctx.Done()
  cleanup()
}()
```

### After

```go
stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, cleanup)
defer stop()
```
